name: reservation-hero
title: Reservation hero
description: A restaurant opening with the table first: party size, a date and tonight's free times as chips, handed to your booking flow.
docs: Pass slots (the same times every day) or slotsFor(date, party), which may return a promise. Dates are plain yyyy-mm-dd strings in the restaurant's own calendar and times are the strings you give; closedDays takes weekdays (0 is Sunday) and dates. Answers that arrive late for a party or date that has since changed are ignored. onReserve({ party, date, time }) is where your booking starts. Today is the restaurant's own day in timeZone and is read from the browser's clock once the page is live: until then the date shows its placeholder and the times a skeleton, so a page built days ago never shows the day it was built. Pass today ("2026-11-06") to pin it for server HTML, tests and previews. slotsFor and onReserve are functions, so use the hero inside a Client Component.
